summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_id and client_secret; client id from login or extra.client_id; client secret from password or extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type to oauth and env-var references for both secrets; no method key, no transform, no claim override). Registered it directly after the token mapping in the profile_mappings list in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, and added it to the imports and __all__ there and in cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim cases, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, profile-arg override of auth_type and secrets, and environment variables. Tests were not run and no code was executed, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
